purpose: descriptive comparison of two susceptibility products (reference only; neither product is ground truth)
disclaimers: RF raster = relative landslide susceptibility ranking conditional on the observed inventory (92.3% of labels from 2018); NOT a calibrated probability, forecast, warning or timing prediction.
GSI 2022 zones (LSZ-01, KSDMA-hosted) are another model-derived susceptibility product, NOT ground truth, NOT geology, NOT validation labels.
Descriptive zone/ranking agreement only; no significance tests; spatial autocorrelation expected in both products.
GSI file covers 95.99% of the GADM 4.1 project boundary and is not field-validated (DOWNLOADED_NOT_FULLY_VALIDATED); zones are NOT extrapolated to the missing GADM area.

rf_map_record.value: RF positive-class vote share predict_proba[:, 1] - a RELATIVE RANKING score, not a calibrated probability
rf_map_record.domain_rule: district mask AND all 24 predictor layers valid
rf_map_record.label: relative landslide susceptibility ranking conditional on the observed inventory (92.3% of labels from 2018); not a probability, forecast, warning, or timing prediction

geometry_repair.method: shapely.validation.make_valid per feature (3/3 delivered features are formally invalid); buffer(0) fallback never needed this run

comparison_domain.note: GADM area not covered by the GSI file is EXCLUDED (no extrapolation)

rf_quantile_method.defined_over: comparison-domain cells only (equal-area 30 m cells; cell quantiles = area-weighted quantiles)
rf_quantile_method.class_share_caveat: score ties (many cells at 0.0) shift measured class shares away from exactly 20% - shares reported as measured
